# no output file generated by phot

**findlay** wrote on Oct 09, 2010

{% raw %}
<div>
Hello all,<br>
<br>
I've been doing some aperture photometry on some SDSS .fits frames using the apphot.phot task in batch mode. I've done this before on non-SDSS images and never had any problems. As far as I can tell the only difference between the sdss and non-sdss images is that the former are a lot larger. <br>
<br>
The problem is that when I run phot on the SDSS images it runs uninterrupted, but there is no output to the terminal and no output file is generated. I decided to run daofind on the images just to see if it encountered similar problems but it did not. I also thought there might be a problem with the image buffer size so I set stdimage=imt2048, still no luck.<br>
<br>
If anyone has encountered similar problems or has any idea what is going on here I would very interested to hear from you. Hope you can help!<br>
<br>
findlay
</div>
{% endraw %}
